hits.title: XML parser factory created without XXE hardening
hits.description: The factory is created and used in this method with no setFeature/setProperty call disabling DTDs or external entities.

hits.title: X509TrustManager accepts every certificate
hits.description: The trust-manager check neither validates the chain nor throws, so any certificate (including a MITM one) is accepted.

hits.title: Weak hash algorithm "MD5"
hits.description: MD5/SHA-1 are collision-broken and unsuitable for passwords, signatures or integrity checks.

hits.title: Weak cipher or ECB mode "AES"
hits.description: Broken cipher, or a block cipher in ECB mode (bare "AES" defaults to ECB), which leaks plaintext patterns.

hits.title: Cookie created without HttpOnly
hits.description: The servlet cookie is built in this method with no setSecure(true)/setHttpOnly(true) call.

hits.title: Hardcoded credential assigned to this.dbPassword
hits.description: A non-placeholder string literal is assigned to a credential-named variable.
